t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Alternate between each gnome to see which averages more. Once you notice the average has changed, select the opposite gnome to score higher points

vb_textbox.text: Alternate between each gnome at the start of the game, you will find that the two colored gnomes paired together will usually be paired throughout the entire game. You will also notice the value will start switching from one gnome to the other.
